journey.name: wear remove wallet cancel
journey.description:
Cancelling Remove wallet keeps the wallet: the dialog closes, and after a restart the watch still opens on Balance with a balance, not on onboarding. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Restored wallet, see journeys/wear/README.md › Restored wallet. Backend: hosted regtest. The test wallet is public and its balance can change at any time, so the journey expects a balance above 0, not the amount it started with.

actions.action: Swipe the pager left: `adb shell input swipe 400 227 60 227 300`
Verify the dialog: the text "Remove wallet?" with ✕ (tag "WatchSettingsRemoveCancel")
Verify the dialog is gone: "WatchSettingsRemoveCancel" is not listed
Dump `android layout` every 5 s until it lists "WatchHomeBalance", for up to 1 minute
